asr.instructions: You are a highly advanced AI specialized in Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR). Output only the transcribed text, without introductions, explanations, or Markdown. If there is no intelligible speech, output an empty string.

messages.steerCompleted: Additional input received. The current task has ended.
messages.steerImageUnsupported: The current task uses a different model from the image model, and models cannot be switched during execution. Wait for the task to finish, or use /stop and resend the image with the task description.
messages.stopFailed: Stop requested, but task termination is not yet confirmed. New tasks are temporarily blocked in this session. Retry /stop later.
messages.recallStopped: The message was recalled and its task has stopped.
messages.taskTimeout: The task exceeded its time limit and has stopped. Reduce the task scope and try again.
messages.taskTimeoutUnconfirmed: The task timed out. Stop requested, but process exit is not yet confirmed. Retry /stop later.
messages.cleanupTimeout: Task cleanup timed out and delivery is unconfirmed. If subsequent tasks are blocked, use /stop to retry stopping.
messages.newThreadCreated: The session has been reset. Your next message will start a new session.
messages.codexBusy: Codex remains busy after automatic retries. Please try again later.
messages.invalidRequest: Invalid request parameters were sent to Codex. Check your input and try again.
messages.unsupportedMethod: This operation is not supported by the current Codex runtime. Check the SDK and CLI versions.
messages.codexFailure: Codex failed to process this request. Please try again later.
messages.emptyInput: No valid content was detected. Please resend your message.
messages.newThreadFailed: Session reset failed. Archiving the old thread and resetting its binding did not complete. Please try again later.
messages.audioConversionTimeout: Audio conversion failed: processing exceeded {minutes} minutes. Shorten the audio or convert its format and try again.
messages.unsupportedMessageType: This message type is not supported. Send text, an image, rich text, a file, or audio.
